blue-counter-tapped-out.note: Jund is tapped out so Force Spike is a hard counter; the public clause Counterspell-not-in-graveyard makes spending Counterspell fail, as does passing.

blue-counter-untapped.note: With a Swamp open the response bot pays Force Spike (traced), so only Counterspell stops Gixian Infiltrator; parity on both engines.

blue-sleep-productive.note: Escaping Sleep onto the untapped Gixian Infiltrator prevents its 2-damage attack on Jund's turn; escaping onto the locked Shaman or passing takes the hit (traced). Weak discriminator: random learners succeed 3/4 when only a target choice remains.

blue-sleep-redundant.note: The engine takes the larger skip-untap count (cards.py:142), as the rules do, so escaping onto the locked Shaman only spends mana and three graveyard cards and always fails the four-card graveyard objective. A pass learner succeeds, which is inherent to a don't-waste-it puzzle; shares a leakage group with blue-sleep-productive.

jund-color-sequencing.note: Cast Down's generic must come from the Forest to keep red for the Shaman; both cast orders succeed and the Mountain payment fails.

jund-shaman-toxin-sweep.note: Toxin on Shaman then sacrificing the Clue sweeps all three ground creatures via deathtouch; Toxin on Serpent/Delver fails (traced) and Terror's ward counters it. Random learners 0/4, a strong discriminator.

jund-survive-attack.note: At 4 life Cast Down plus ward {2} is unaffordable, so only the chump block survives; the Cast-Down-not-in-graveyard clause correctly rejects wasting the removal and then blocking.
